title: Solve Quadratic Assignment Problems (QAP) — qap
text: QAP facilities location problem. Given \(n\) facilities \(n\) locations matrix \(\) specifying flows facilities matrix \(B\) location distances, find best facility location assignment minimizes total transportation cost given flow times distance. assignment represented permutation matrix \(X\) objective $$\mathrm{min}_{X \\Pi}\; tr(AXBX^T)$$ iqap.obj calculates objective function \(\) \(B\) permutation o. Although, QAP introduced combinatorial optimization problem facility location problem operations research (see Koopmans Beckmann;1957), also many applications data analysis (see Hubert Schultz; 1976). QAP known NP-hard. function implements simple simulated annealing heuristic described Burkard Rendl (1984). code based Rendl's FORTRAN implementation algorithm available QAPLIB website. authors suggests can produce heuristic solutions QAPs dimension 256 objects less. However, hard limit implementation. solver additional arguments rep = 1L, miter = 2 * nrow(), fiter = 1.1,   ft = 0.5 maxsteps = 50L rep integer; number restarts. miter integer; number iterations fixed temperature. fiter multiplication factor miter miter       random transposition trials. ft multiplication factor t miter random       transposition trials (0 1). maxsteps integer; maximal number allowed cooling steps.
